title: Cookie policy
seoDescription: Cookie policy of Instal Berrozpe and operation of the website's multilingual consent system.
intro: This website uses technical storage to remember your cookie choice. It does not activate analytics or advertising tools.

sections.heading: Preference storage
body: The site code saves the choice in localStorage under berrozpe-cookie-consent and in the berrozpe-cookie-consent-cookie cookie. The cookie lasts 180 days; localStorage remains until the user clears it.
This technical preference is needed to remember whether optional categories were accepted or rejected.

sections.heading: Accept, reject and configure
body: The banner lets users accept all optional categories, reject them or open the settings. Accept and reject are presented at the same level with equivalent visibility.
The specific Google Maps option controls loading the interactive map and remains off until the user enables it. Analytics and marketing remain prepared with no confirmed tools.

sections.heading: Google Maps and external services
body: The map is not requested before specific authorization for Google Maps. It can be enabled with “Show Google Map” or in cookie settings.

Showing the map connects the browser directly to Google Maps. Removing Google Maps authorization removes the iframe; the address and external link remain available. The preference can be changed from the footer.

pendingReviewNote: The Google Maps description matches the implemented specific consent; final legal review remains pending.
